champion: Saelo, Keeper of the Still Hour
source: GDD gdd/lanebound-champions-v4.0-notion.md (Lanebound v4.0, L7 kit); look from champions/portraits/painted/saelo/saelo-1024.png (CD-7)
note: Blue faces right and red faces left. Blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Team tint only on the chain clasp. Lilac coat and pewter dial; the lime second hand is the only bright accent. Still-Field units turn pewter-lilac with no grain or crack (petrify is warm granite with a crack).

idle.note: breath; the dial halo ticks (second hand steps on 2)

walk.note: measured stride; coat sways, key-staff upright

attack.note: tick pulse (line, 5.5): key-staff dips, a pewter tick leaves the key bow on 3

cast.note: generic cast: staff up, dial brightens

rewound.note: Passive Rewound Moment (once per fight below 30% HP): the dial spins backwards and a ticked shield (25% max HP, 2.5 s) closes around her

secondhand.note: Q Second Hand: reach back to the dial (1), pluck the lime second hand (2), wind (3), throw on 4 (0.30 s cast); line 7 x 0.5, slow 30% 1.2 s; the dial regrows its hand on 7

unwind.note: W Unwind: key-staff out, the key turns backwards (1-2), lands on 3 (0.25 s cast): ally heal + basic dispel

stillhour.note: R Still Hour: staff raised (1), key set in the air (2), turned (3), the dial swells (4-6); the Still-Field lands on 7 (0.70 s cast): r 2.4 at up to 8 tiles, time-stop 2.0 s on every unit inside but Saelo, allies too

death.note: dial stops, kneel, fall; last frame holds

slow.note: Q: 30% slow 1.2 s, shared drag + slow plate

timestop.note: R: time-stop 2.0 s: body turns still pewter-lilac (no grain, no crack: not stone), NEW timestop plate, projectiles inside freeze; map-wide: a ring sweeps the whole view on landing and a ticked bezel frames the screen while it lasts
